description: This file is a PHP script for testing and inspecting the TestLink test management system. It includes setup, multiple test method calls on a 'testplan' object, and output formatting for test statuses and results.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: The class instance used to manage test plan related operations, invoked with the variable '$obj_mgr'.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnLatestExecution
methods.description: Retrieves hit statuses based on the latest execution for the specified test plan and platform.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnBuild
methods.description: Retrieves hit statuses for a specific build within a test plan and platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunOnBuild
methods.description: Retrieves test hits that have not been run on a specific build.

methods.name: getHitsSameStatusFull
methods.description: Retrieves all hits with specific statuses, grouped by status, for a test plan and platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunFull
methods.description: Gets all hits that haven't been executed or assigned a status yet.

methods.name: getHitsSingleStatusFull
methods.description: Retrieves hits with a specific single status within the test plan and platform.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetFull
methods.description: Retrieves hits with any of the statuses in a set for the specified test plan and platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunPartial
methods.description: Gets a subset of hits that have not been run, used for partial data retrieval.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetPartial
methods.description: Retrieves hits with statuses in a set, for partial data retrieval.
